title: How to Export Projects
summary: Export project data for reporting and offline review.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.body: This guide shows how to export project data from the EPIC Database, including all projects or only projects that match selected filters.

steps.title: Open export options
steps.body: Click the download icon to open the export options.

steps.title: Choose export content
steps.body: Choose how you want to customize and export your project data.

steps.title: Export the entire database
steps.body: Click Entire Database to export all data records from the EPIC Database without applying filters.

steps.title: Open project filters
steps.body: To export only selected projects, click the filter icon to review and apply project filters before exporting.

steps.title: Select your filters
steps.body: Use the available filter options to narrow the project list before exporting.

steps.title: Filter by program administration
steps.body: For example, filter projects by Program Administration so the export only includes projects assigned to that program area.

steps.title: Filter by low-income community
steps.body: You can also select Low Income Community to include only projects that serve low-income communities.

steps.title: Return to export options
steps.body: After applying the filters, click the download icon again to continue with the export.

steps.title: Export filtered results
steps.body: Click Filtered Results to export only the projects that match your applied filters.
